pr_title: Fix a possible race condition on popup close, that might cause multiple deletions of the same list item.
pr_body:
Depending on how fast OS processes a window close request, the window close event might arrive before the cleanup loop is finished (and delete the list item which is currently processed by the loop, causing invalid memory access).

So instead of removing nested popups directly, cleanup is changed to find the deepest popup to close, and send a close request to this window only, the rest (closing child popups) is handled by this window close event handler.

TODO:
- [x] Test on macOS.
- [x] Test on Windows.
- [x] Test on Linux.

Fixes: #59906
